above_prefix_reversal.type_text:
above_prefix_reversal
     : forall (v : lang_base.stack) (n : nat),
       @eq (list lang_base.item)
         (@List.firstn lang_base.item (Nat.sub (@length lang_base.item v) n)
            (@list.reverse lang_base.item v))
         (@list.reverse lang_base.item (@List.skipn lang_base.item n v))

granting_index_reversal.type_text:
granting_index_reversal
     : forall (v : lang_base.stack) (g : nat) (it : lang_base.item)
         (_ : @eq (option lang_base.item)
                (@base.lookup nat lang_base.item lang_base.stack
                   (@list.list_lookup lang_base.item) g v)
                (@Some lang_base.item it)),
       @eq (option lang_base.item)
         (@base.lookup nat lang_base.item (list lang_base.item)
            (@list.list_lookup lang_base.item)
            (Nat.sub (Nat.sub (@length lang_base.item v) (S O)) g)
            (@list.reverse lang_base.item v)) (@Some lang_base.item it)

historical_srw_characterization.type_text:
historical_srw_characterization
     : forall (above : lang_base.stack) (k : nat)
         (_ : succeeding_boundary above k),
       @eq (option nat)
         (bor_semantics.find_first_write_incompatible
            (@list.reverse lang_base.item above) lang_base.SharedReadWrite)
         (@Some nat (Nat.sub (@length lang_base.item above) k))

historical_vector_boundary_equality.type_text:
historical_vector_boundary_equality
     : forall (v : lang_base.stack) (g : nat) (pm : lang_base.permission)
         (r : nat) (_ : vector_boundary v g pm r),
       @eq (option nat)
         (bor_semantics.find_first_write_incompatible
            (@List.firstn lang_base.item
               (Nat.sub (Nat.sub (@length lang_base.item v) (S O)) g)
               (@list.reverse lang_base.item v)) pm)
         (@Some nat (Nat.sub (@length lang_base.item v) r))

vector_boundary.type_text:
vector_boundary
     : forall (_ : lang_base.stack) (_ : nat) (_ : lang_base.permission)
         (_ : nat), Prop

vector_suffix_characterization.type_text:
vector_suffix_characterization
     : forall (v : lang_base.stack) (g r : nat)
         (_ : vector_boundary v g lang_base.SharedReadWrite r),
       succeeding_boundary (@List.skipn lang_base.item (S g) v)
         (Nat.sub r (S g))
